description: **SET THE DATA SELECTOR TO 'All Data'** (top left). Unprotected endpoints from Network Discovery: Active devices seen on the network that have no SentinelOne agent (Missing Protection: EPP). Counts match the Network Discovery page in Asset Inventory. The asset inventory is a current snapshot, so the time picker does not change these numbers.

graphs.title: About this dashboard
graphs.markdown:
**Set the data selector to All Data**, or every panel errors with `Invalid column 'dataSource.category'`.

Scope: Network Discovery devices with **Asset Status = Active** (the Network Discovery page view). **Missing EPP** = no SentinelOne agent on the device. **EPP-supported type** = Network Discovery classifies the device type as able to run the agent (`eppUnsupportedUnknown = Supported`): these are the deploy candidates for Sentinel Deploy. Devices of Unknown or Unsupported type (IoT, network gear, TVs) are listed but are not agent deploy targets.

The device list shows the 1,000 most recently active unprotected devices; the Active devices missing EPP panel gives the full count.

A zero in the Missing EPP panels is the desired posture.

graphs.title: Active Network Discovery devices
graphs.query: | datasource assets from 'surface/networkDiscovery' | filter assetStatus = 'Active' | group devices = count() | limit 1

graphs.title: Active devices missing EPP (no agent)
graphs.query: | datasource assets from 'surface/networkDiscovery' | filter assetStatus = 'Active' | filter missingCoverage contains 'EPP' | group devices = count() | limit 1

graphs.title: Missing EPP on an EPP-supported device type (deploy candidates)
graphs.query: | datasource assets from 'surface/networkDiscovery' | filter assetStatus = 'Active' | filter missingCoverage contains 'EPP' | filter eppUnsupportedUnknown = 'Supported' | group devices = count() | limit 1

graphs.title: Missing EPP by device type
graphs.query: | datasource assets from 'surface/networkDiscovery' | filter assetStatus = 'Active' | filter missingCoverage contains 'EPP' | let device_type = (resourceType != null ? resourceType : 'Not reported') | group devices = count() by device_type | sort -devices | limit 10

graphs.title: Missing EPP by agent support (EPP-supported, Unknown, Unsupported)
graphs.query: | datasource assets from 'surface/networkDiscovery' | filter assetStatus = 'Active' | filter missingCoverage contains 'EPP' | let agent_support = (eppUnsupportedUnknown != null ? eppUnsupportedUnknown : 'Not reported') | group devices = count() by agent_support | sort -devices | limit 5

graphs.title: Missing EPP by site
graphs.query: | datasource assets from 'surface/networkDiscovery' | filter assetStatus = 'Active' | filter missingCoverage contains 'EPP' | let site = (s1SiteName != null ? s1SiteName : 'Not reported') | group devices = count() by site | sort -devices | limit 50

graphs.title: Missing EPP by OS family
graphs.query: | datasource assets from 'surface/networkDiscovery' | filter assetStatus = 'Active' | filter missingCoverage contains 'EPP' | let os_family = (osFamily != null ? osFamily : 'Not reported') | group devices = count() by os_family | sort -devices | limit 20

graphs.title: Missing EPP by device review status
graphs.query: | datasource assets from 'surface/networkDiscovery' | filter assetStatus = 'Active' | filter missingCoverage contains 'EPP' | let review_status = (deviceReview != null ? deviceReview : 'Not reported') | group devices = count() by review_status | sort -devices | limit 10

graphs.title: All Active Network Discovery devices by managed state
graphs.query: | datasource assets from 'surface/networkDiscovery' | filter assetStatus = 'Active' | let managed_state = (managedState != null ? managedState : 'Not reported') | group devices = count() by managed_state | sort -devices | limit 10

graphs.title: All Active Network Discovery devices by discovery method
graphs.query: | datasource assets from 'surface/networkDiscovery' | filter assetStatus = 'Active' | group devices = count() by discovery_method = discoveryMethods | sort -devices | limit 15

graphs.title: Unprotected devices (Active, missing EPP): the 1,000 most recently active
graphs.query: | datasource assets from 'surface/networkDiscovery' | filter assetStatus = 'Active' | filter missingCoverage contains 'EPP' | columns device = name, ip = ipAddress, device_type = resourceType, os_family = osFamily, agent_support = eppUnsupportedUnknown, managed_state = managedState, review_status = deviceReview, site = s1SiteName, last_active = lastActiveDt | sort -last_active | limit 1000

graphs.title: False-positive check
graphs.markdown: Network Discovery can list a device that already runs the agent as Missing EPP. The panels below check every Missing EPP device against the agent-backed endpoint assets, by MAC, by IP with the same gateway MAC, and by hostname, with the matching rules of the Unprotected Endpoints report. **Likely false positive** = a live agent reports the device's MAC, or its IP and hostname. **Review** = hostname only, IP only, or the matched agent has not been active for 30 days: still counted in the gap. Decommissioned agents removed from the inventory cannot be seen here, so a device whose agent was removed shows as no match; the report checks those through the Management API. An empty list means no Missing EPP device matched an agent. These panels join two inventories and load more slowly than the rest.

graphs.title: Missing EPP devices by agent cross-check verdict
graphs.query:
| union
 ( | datasource assets from 'surface/networkDiscovery' | filter assetStatus = 'Active' missingCoverage contains 'EPP' | let nm = lower(replace(name != null ? name : '', '\\..*$', ''))
| let nameOk = len(nm) >= 3 && !(nm matches '^[0-9-]+$') && !(nm matches '^([0-9a-f]{2}[:-]?){5}[0-9a-f]{2}$') && !(nm matches '^(unknown.*|localhost|iphone.*|ipad.*|watch|android.*|galaxy.*|macbook.*|imac|raspberrypi)$')
| let macKeys = array_from_json(macAddresses != null ? macAddresses : '[]').map(func(x) -> 'mac:' + replace(lower(x), '[^0-9a-f]', '')).filter(func(k) -> k matches '^mac:[0-9a-f][048c][0-9a-f]{10}$' && k != 'mac:000000000000' && k != 'mac:00059a3c7a00')
| let ipKeys = array_from_json(networkInterfaces != null ? networkInterfaces : '[]').map(func(i) -> 'ip:' + json_object_value(i, 'ip') + '@' + replace(lower(json_object_value(i, 'gatewayMac')), '[^0-9a-f]', '')).filter(func(k) -> k matches '^ip:[0-9]+[.][0-9]+[.][0-9]+[.][0-9]+@[0-9a-f]{12}$' && !(k matches '@(00005e0001|00000c07ac|00000c9ff|123456789abc)'))
| let keys = macKeys.concat(ipKeys).concat(nameOk ? array('name:' + nm) : array()) | let key = keys.concat(array('self:' + id)).expand() | let nd = id + '|' + name + '|' + s1SiteName | columns key, nd ),
 ( | datasource assets from 'surface/endpoint' | let nm = lower(replace(name != null ? name : '', '\\..*$', ''))
| let nameOk = len(nm) >= 3 && !(nm matches '^[0-9-]+$') && !(nm matches '^([0-9a-f]{2}[:-]?){5}[0-9a-f]{2}$') && !(nm matches '^(unknown.*|localhost|iphone.*|ipad.*|watch|android.*|galaxy.*|macbook.*|imac|raspberrypi)$')
| let macKeys = array_from_json(macAddresses != null ? macAddresses : '[]').map(func(x) -> 'mac:' + replace(lower(x), '[^0-9a-f]', '')).filter(func(k) -> k matches '^mac:[0-9a-f][048c][0-9a-f]{10}$' && k != 'mac:000000000000' && k != 'mac:00059a3c7a00')
| let ipKeys = array_from_json(networkInterfaces != null ? networkInterfaces : '[]').map(func(i) -> 'ip:' + json_object_value(i, 'ip') + '@' + replace(lower(json_object_value(i, 'gatewayMac')), '[^0-9a-f]', '')).filter(func(k) -> k matches '^ip:[0-9]+[.][0-9]+[.][0-9]+[.][0-9]+@[0-9a-f]{12}$' && !(k matches '@(00005e0001|00000c07ac|00000c9ff|123456789abc)'))
| let keys = macKeys.concat(ipKeys).concat(nameOk ? array('name:' + nm) : array()) | let key = keys.expand() | let ageDays = lastActiveDt != null ? (now() - strptime(substr(lastActiveDt, 0, 19), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S')) / 86400000000000 : 0 | let live = assetStatus = 'Active' && activeCoverage contains 'EPP' | let ep = id + '=' + name + '@' + s1SiteName | let epAct = live && ageDays <= 30 ? ep : null, epOld = live && ageDays > 30 ? ep : null, epIn = live ? null : ep | columns key, epAct, epOld, epIn )
| group nds = array_agg_distinct(nd, 200), ndc = count(nd != null), act = array_agg_distinct(epAct, 20), old = array_agg_distinct(epOld, 20), inact = array_agg_distinct(epIn, 20) by key
| filter ndc > 0
| let shared = key matches '^mac:' && ndc > 1
| let ag = shared ? '' : act.filter(func(x) -> x != null).to_string(',')
| let og = shared ? '' : old.filter(func(x) -> x != null).to_string(',')
| let inactive = shared ? 0 : (ag == '' && og == '' && inact.filter(func(x) -> x != null).len() > 0 ? 1 : 0)
| let isMac = key matches '^mac:', isIp = key matches '^ip:', isName = key matches '^name:'
| let n = nds.expand()
| filter n != null
| group macA = array_agg_distinct(isMac && ag != '' ? ag : null, 50), ipA = array_agg_distinct(isIp && ag != '' ? ag : null, 50), nmA = array_agg_distinct(isName && ag != '' ? ag : null, 50), macO = array_agg_distinct(isMac && og != '' ? og : null, 50), ipO = array_agg_distinct(isIp && og != '' ? og : null, 50), nmO = array_agg_distinct(isName && og != '' ? og : null, 50), inactN = sum(inactive) by n
| let macAs = macA.filter(func(x) -> x != null).to_string(','), ipAs = ipA.filter(func(x) -> x != null).to_string(','), nmAs = nmA.filter(func(x) -> x != null).to_string(',')
| let macOs = macO.filter(func(x) -> x != null).to_string(','), ipOs = ipO.filter(func(x) -> x != null).to_string(','), nmOs = nmO.filter(func(x) -> x != null).to_string(',')
| let bothA = extract_matches(ipAs, '(?:^|,)([a-z0-9-]+)=').intersect(extract_matches(nmAs, '(?:^|,)([a-z0-9-]+)='))
| let bothO = extract_matches(ipOs, '(?:^|,)([a-z0-9-]+)=').intersect(extract_matches(nmOs, '(?:^|,)([a-z0-9-]+)='))
| let rank = macAs != '' ? 1 : (bothA.len() > 0 ? 2 : (macOs != '' || bothO.len() > 0 ? 5 : (nmAs != '' || nmOs != '' ? 3 : (ipAs != '' || ipOs != '' ? 4 : (inactN > 0 ? 6 : 7)))))
| let pickId = rank == 2 ? bothA.get(0) : (rank == 5 && macOs == '' ? bothO.get(0) : '')
| let agentList = rank == 1 ? macAs : (rank == 5 ? macOs : (rank == 3 ? (nmAs != '' ? nmAs : nmOs) : (rank == 4 ? (ipAs != '' ? ipAs : ipOs) : '')))
| let srcList = rank == 2 ? nmAs : nmOs
| let picked = pickId != '' ? srcList.split(',').filter(func(x) -> substr(x, 0, len(pickId) + 1) == pickId + '=').get(0) : replace(agentList, ',.*$', '')
| let agent = replace(picked, '^[a-z0-9-]+=', '')
| let verdict = rank == 1 ? 'Likely false positive: agent MAC matches' : (rank == 2 ? 'Likely false positive: agent IP and hostname match' : (rank == 3 ? 'Review: hostname matches an agent' : (rank == 4 ? 'Review: IP matches an agent' : (rank == 5 ? 'Review: matched agent has been offline' : (rank == 6 ? 'Unprotected: matched agent is not active' : 'Unprotected: no agent match')))))
| group devices = count() by verdict, rank
| sort rank
| columns verdict, devices
| limit 10

graphs.title: Missing EPP devices by identity strength
graphs.query: | datasource assets from 'surface/networkDiscovery' | filter assetStatus = 'Active' | filter missingCoverage contains 'EPP' | let nm = lower(replace(name != null ? name : '', '\\..*$', '')) | let nameOk = len(nm) >= 3 && !(nm matches '^[0-9-]+$') && !(nm matches '^([0-9a-f]{2}[:-]?){5}[0-9a-f]{2}$') && !(nm matches '^(unknown.*|localhost|iphone.*|ipad.*|watch|android.*|galaxy.*|macbook.*|imac|raspberrypi)$') | let macKeys = array_from_json(macAddresses != null ? macAddresses : '[]').map(func(x) -> 'mac:' + replace(lower(x), '[^0-9a-f]', '')).filter(func(k) -> k matches '^mac:[0-9a-f][048c][0-9a-f]{10}$' && k != 'mac:000000000000' && k != 'mac:00059a3c7a00') | let anyMac = array_from_json(macAddresses != null ? macAddresses : '[]').len() > 0 | let identity = anyMac == false ? 'No MAC address' : (macKeys.len() == 0 ? 'Randomised or shared MAC only' : (nameOk ? 'Hardware MAC and hostname' : 'Hardware MAC, no usable hostname')) | group devices = count() by identity | sort -devices | limit 10
